text: Wha—? Lee?\nHow’d you manage to find your way here?\r\nYou’re pants with directions. You always get lost.[VAR 0114(0005)]

Oh, that’s nice to hear from the little brother
who had me worried sick!\c
I’d been waiting ages for you two, and you
never showed!\c
Of course I came looking for the both of you![VAR 0114(0004)]
Wait, where’s the Wooloo?!\nWe were trying to rescue that Wooloo![VAR 0114(0005)]

The little chap’s just fine.\c
Though all of you had fainted by the time I
found you here.\c
You know this place is out of bounds...\c
But it took courage to come in here all the same.
And I can understand well enough why you did it.\c
You did good, Hop![VAR 0114(0004)]

And at least that Wooloo’s all right...
Yeah, [VAR 0100(0000)]?\c
I thought we’d had it when that weird fog started
rolling in and that mad Pokémon attacked...
but at least it wasn’t all for nothing![VAR 0114(0005)]
Attacked by some mad Pokémon?\nWhat are you talking about, Hop?[VAR 0114(0004)]

It seemed loads stronger than any Pokémon I’ve
ever seen. And it just had this sort of presence...
Our moves didn’t even touch it. I mean, really—
they seemed to pass right through it![VAR 0114(0005)]

Your moves passed right through it?\c
So, the fearsome Pokémon they say live in the
Slumbering Weald...
Are they actually illusions or something?[VAR 0114(0004)]
Get strong enough and maybe the two of you\ncould be the ones to reveal the truth someday.[VAR 0114(0004)]
For now, let’s simply get out of this place.\nYou’ll be all right now that I’m here with you![VAR 0114(0004)]
Even if we did get an earful from Lee...[VAR 0114(0005)]
what an experience! This’ll make a pretty fine\nfirst page in the tale of my legend![VAR 0114(0005)]
